🚧 Traffic Restored on NH-44 near Thard, J&K
After a massive landslide on Sept 2, traffic is now moving via a 2-lane temporary diversion. NHAI & J&K Traffic Police urge travelers to follow advisories & lane discipline. Full restoration underway.
#NH44 #JammuKashmir #TrafficUpdate https://t.co/3eZaxENFD0
